summary: Empty the colour-literal allowlist directory by directory, stop the ratchet reading prose as colour, and end with a register of documented exceptions rather than a backlog

coordination.notes: Continues Lane I from the session that landed I1 and I2 rather than starting a rival ratchet: tools/color-token-test.mjs and its allowlist are that session's files and are extended in place. Lane D is editing src/App.tsx and moving panels between src/components directories concurrently; the allowlist is keyed on {file, literal, count}, so a moved file changes its key and the ratchet says so on rebase - rebased and re-run after each. The conflict matrix reserves RoomBackdrop.tsx and RoomScene.tsx to `rewrite/remove-2d` until C7 is decided; C7 is [x] as of 5 Sep, and `git diff --stat origin/main...origin/rewrite/remove-2d -- src/components/room/` shows that branch deleting RoomBackdrop.tsx outright, which is recorded in the I4 handling rather than guessed at. Two things worth passing on. The browser pane drifted onto another session's dev server on :5199 mid-verification and reported a class of mine as absent - a true statement about the wrong application; every measurement quoted here was re-taken with location.origin asserted to be my own port 1439. And an Edit wrote a literal NUL byte into tools/color-token-test.mjs, which grep reports only as "Binary file matches"; it is an escape sequence now, matching how the rest of the file writes that separator.

checks: I5, I6 (PR #303): node tools/color-token-test.mjs -> remaining 52 -> 49, all passed; the other 49 entries still match, which is the control that stripComments did not eat code

I3: node tools/color-token-test.mjs -> remaining 49 -> 30, all passed, 39 checks; src/components/shared is empty of literals

I3 measured in the running app at 127.0.0.1:1439 (dev server, demo dashboard): .board-puck x40, .board-pill x1, .board-wash x1 computed styles are byte-identical to the inline strings they replaced, including var(--color-scrim) resolving to rgba(0,0,0,0.5); .board-disc verified live at ?view=panel&id=room, 296x296, same gradient. Zero appearance change for CombatRadar.

I3 MindstateBoard is a deliberate appearance change and was measured rather than eyeballed: the eight bands composited at 32% over --color-surface give adjacent steps 10,11,30,33,10,9,22 against the old ramp 13,16,54,70,21,22,15. The amber-to-red half is compressed because --color-warn and --color-danger sit close in this palette; both intermediate mixes are 50/50, the maximin split, checked at 50/40/30/25/20. The step that got bigger is nearly-locked to mind lock, 15 -> 22, which is the one boundary the board exists to make unmissable.
npx tsc -b exit 0; node tools/run-tests.mjs all passed; node tools/plan-audit.mjs plan ok
I4, I9: node tools/color-token-test.mjs -> remaining 30 -> 27, all passed, 36 checks. RoomScene fixed (3); RoomBackdrop 24 and config 3 kept with a `why` each.

I4 the 24 RoomBackdrop notes were generated by parsing that file's own TERRAIN table, not typed from memory, and the script exits non-zero if any literal fails to match a palette - so a wrong note cannot be written silently.

I4 looked at: .room-art-pending rendered at 340x212 beside the literal it replaces, in the running app. Same geometry; the old one is visibly the cold blue-grey rectangle the theme comment at the top of index.css describes discarding.

I11: an allowlist entry with no `why` is now a failure, and one shorter than 40 characters is too. Final state: `of those, 27 are documented permanent exceptions and 0 still owe a token`, all passed, 63 checks.

I11: --write used to rebuild the file from scratch, which would have erased all 27 explanations and left a green run, because a bare entry was legal when that flag was written. It carries them across now and warns on any it cannot match.

I11 sabotage, three, each firing on its own check and nothing else, control green either side: remove one `why` -> FAIL ... has no `why`, and the split line correctly re-reads it as "1 still owe a token"; shorten a `why` to seven characters -> FAIL ... is not an explanation; the floor is 40; put #1d2229 back into RoomScene as code -> FAIL ... new raw colour. md5 7fd30a5b6acb (allowlist) and f1d66508eff7 (RoomScene) restored.

rebased onto origin/main three times during the lane (C11, then D1-D3 + F1) and re-ran the ratchet after each - the allowlist is keyed on {file, literal, count}, so a file Lane D moved between directories would have changed its key and gone red. It stayed green.
